restoration_note: The teaching frames the five customary gestures of human society — wishing peace, greeting, offering the right hand/kiss, bowing, and laying hands to honor — as the visible echo of the Five Mysteries by which the Divine Human (First Man) goes forth into contest with the self and is brought home. The text exhibits dense parallel structure (going-out / coming-back of each mystery), and the bulk of gaps are morphological line-break completions whose fills are forced by the visible halves of split words (ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ, ⲣⲁⲥⲡⲁϩⲉ, ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ, ⲡⲏⲓ̈, ⲡⲉϩⲥⲱⲙⲁ, ⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ, ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ, ⲁⲗⲧⲉⲗⲟⲥ). The opening question-formulae and the closing soul-redemption sequence required correspondential reasoning anchored in the lexicon (form of light = Virgin of Light / divine receivability; embrace = ἀσπασμός as conjunction of love; crown of light = wreath of completed regeneration). Sections 572–573 (gaps 41–45) are too damaged to recover with discipline and are left unrestored; gap 5 is restored at moderate confidence as a parallel "to whom does it belong?" formula matching lines 476 and 482.
